;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Lahore bombing]]
**A blast near the 11th-century [[Data Darbar]] [[Sufism|Sufi]] shrine in [[Lahore]], [[Pakistan]], kills at least eleven people, half of them police officers. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/08/pakistan-dead-blast-near-major-sufi-shrine-lahore (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-blast-idUSKCN1SE0C2 (Reuters)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**Nine people were killed after the [[Taliban]] launches an attack on the [[Kabul]] offices of [[international non-governmental organization]] [[Counterpart International]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/taliban-attack-based-aid-group-raises-concern-kabul-190509093336327.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present)]]
**Syrian government forces capture the town of [[Kafr Nabudah]] in an ongoing [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present)|offensive]], marking the first major territorial change between government and rebel forces since the start of the [[Idlib demilitarization (2018–present)|demilitarization agreement]] last year. [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/article230156544.html (''Miami Herald'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex|Prince Harry]] and [[Meghan, Duchess of Sussex|Meghan]], the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, name their son [[Archie Mountbatten-Windsor|Archie Harrison Mountbatten-Windsor]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/royal-baby-name-prince-harry-meghan-son-named-archie-harrison-mountbatten-windsor-today-live-updates-2019-05/ (CBS News)]

;International relations
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**[[President of Iran|Iranian President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] sends letters to the [[P5+1]] leaders of the [[United Kingdom]], [[China]], [[Russia]], [[Germany]], [[France]] and the [[European Union]] announcing the country's partial withdrawal from the 2015 [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]] agreement. Furthermore, Iran announces that it will stop exporting uranium and [[heavy water]] from its nuclear program. [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/article230153944.html (''Miami Herald'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nuclear-deal-iran-announces-partial-withdrawal-2015-pact/ (CBS News)]
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**[[Taiwan]] passes a law under which [[Chinese intelligence activity abroad|spies from China]] would be subject to life imprisonment or even the [[Capital punishment in Taiwan|death penalty]]. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20190508/p2g/00m/0in/105000c (Mainichi)]
*[[Brazil–United States relations]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] notifies the [[United States Congress|Congress]] that he will designate [[Brazil]] as a [[major non-NATO ally]] in light of recent commitments to increase defense cooperation between both countries. [https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements/message-congress-designating-brazil-major-non-nato-ally/ (White House)]
* [[Belizean–Guatemalan territorial dispute]]
** In a [[2019 Belizean territorial dispute referendum|referendum]], 55.37% of the Belizean population voted in favor of allowing the [[International Court of Justice]] to adjudicate Belize's border dispute with its neighbor [[Guatemala]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belize-referendum-guatemala-border/belizeans-vote-for-un-court-to-settle-guatemala-border-dispute-idUSKCN1SF1QT (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Asia Bibi blasphemy case]]
**Asia Bibi, a Christian woman acquitted of blasphemy after spending eight years on death row, has left [[Pakistan]] for [[Canada]] to be reunited with her daughters. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/reports-christian-acquitted-blasphemy-leaves-pakistan-62897224 (ABC News)]
*Aftermath of the [[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**The [[United States House Committee on the Judiciary]] votes to hold [[United States Attorney General]] [[William Barr]] in [[contempt of Congress]] after he failed to comply with a subpoena ordering him to provide them with the full, unredacted version of the [[Mueller report]] last week. The full House will vote on the measure in the near future. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/08/us/politics/trump-executive-privilege-mueller-report.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Donald Trump Jr.]], son of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], is subpoenaed to testify before the [[United States Senate Select Committee on Intelligence]] about the [[Trump Tower Moscow]] project and [[Links between Trump associates and Russian officials#Donald Trump Jr.|his Russian contacts]] in June 2016. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/08/us/politics/donald-trump-jr-subpoena.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 South African general election]]
**Voters in [[South Africa]] go to the polls to elect new members of the [[National Assembly of South Africa|National Assembly]] and [[Provincial legislature (South Africa)|provincial legislatures]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/08/world/africa/south-africa-election.html (''The New York Times'')]
